description: The bar chart titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment" compares the runtime in seconds of different models within a streaming environment. The vertical axis, labeled "Runtime (seconds)," is linear and represents the runtime values, with a range from 0 to 400 seconds. The horizontal axis lists the names of the models: "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude." The chart features two sets of bars for each model, with the first set representing "Our Joint Framework" in green and the second set representing "LLM Models" in blue. The runtime for "Our Joint Framework" is 77 seconds for the first model, 190 seconds for "ChatGPT," 365 seconds for "DeepSeek," 172 seconds for "LLaMA," and 243 seconds for "Claude." The "LLM Models" runtime values are not explicitly labeled for each model but are indicated by the height of the blue bars. The chart does not include any bars that are sorted in a specific way, such as descending or alphabetical order, nor are any bars visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations. The chart is designed to provide a direct comparison of the runtime performance of the two sets of models across the different models listed.
